g.text: SubQueryRetrievalWorkflow (×N, parallel) — deterministic, no tool-pick LLM

text.tspan: • Deterministic retrieval — NO 'LLM picks next tool' loop
• Only 3 LLM roles touched: plan + coverage (small) , synthesize (large)
• Queues: small activities → kb-search-small ; synthesis pinned → kb-search-large
• FAIL-OPEN at coverage, graph_walk, rerank (never block the answer)
co-ranks graph + vector · FAIL-OPEN ⇒ capped merged pool
